title: Grilled Peach Bourbon Smash
description: This grilled peach and bourbon smash recipe features mint leaves, simple syrup, lemon juice, ginger ale, and bourbon for a perfect summer cocktail.
ingredients: 1 large peach – halved, stone removed, and skin on
4 fluid ounces ginger ale, or as needed

steps.text: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium-high heat and lightly oil the grate. When the grill is hot, close the lid, heat for 5 minutes.

Place peach halves and lemon, cut-sides down, in sugar until coated. Place on the grill; cook until soft, about 5 minutes. Transfer to a cutting board to cool, about 1 minute. Cut peach into slices; reserve 2 slices for garnish.

Place peach slices, mint leaves, and simple syrup into a cocktail shaker; juice lemon into the shaker. Gently mash with a cocktail muddler. Pour in bourbon and ice, cover, and shake until the outside of the shaker has frosted. Strain into a chilled glass; top with ginger ale, and garnish with grilled peach slices and lemon.

video.description: Everything’s peachy in this smashing good summer cocktail! First dip peach halves and lemon in sugar, then grill until beautifully caramelized. Then smash! (Or rather, gently muddle) the fruit with the squeezed juice, simple and mint leaves. Add bourbon and ice and shake until chilled. Strain into an icy glass, top with ginger ale and serve with a grilled peach garnish and mint.
